name: Farren's Proof
summary: At Southshore, Farren's Proof brings Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's report to Marshal Redpath. The murloc heads prove the work is done, though Farren will not carry them himself.

sections.title: A Squeamish Officer
sections.body: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle patrols and secures Hillsbrad Foothills' southern coast, but the brutal work of frontier warfare turns his stomach. After you cull the murlocs along the beaches, he cannot bring himself to touch the severed heads you bring back as proof. He sends you across Southshore to deliver them to the town's command.

sections.title: Report to Redpath
sections.body: Marshal Redpath oversees Southshore's defenses and military readiness as threats rise from Tarren Mill and wild beasts. He receives the sack of murloc heads from you instead of directly from Farren. Redpath knows you have become Farren's errand runner, but accepts the help. Southshore needs every willing hand to keep its borders safe.

faq.q: Why doesn't Lieutenant Farren deliver the murloc heads himself?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren has no wish to handle a sack of severed murloc heads. After sending you to fight, he leaves the delivery to you as well.
Marshal Redpath is Southshore's senior Alliance military commander. He oversees local defense, coordinates the town guards, and handles threats to the human settlement in Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Where does this delivery lead next in the quest chain?
faq.answer: The delivery leads to more duties from Marshal Redpath and Lieutenant Farren, then official dispatches about troop deployments and paperwork sent to Stormwind.

faq.q: Why are murlocs a priority for Southshore's garrison?
faq.answer: Murloc tribes gather densely along Hillsbrad's beaches. They threaten coastal supply routes, harass local fishermen, and endanger Southshore's southern approach while the town faces the Forsaken to the north.

faq.q: What does Marshal Redpath think of Lieutenant Farren's conduct?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath knows Farren's habits and dryly remarks that you have become Farren's errand runner. He welcomes the help because Southshore is hard-pressed and needs capable hands.

faq.q: Where is Marshal Redpath located in Southshore?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath is near Southshore's town center and council building, overseeing the settlement's daily defenses.

angles.text: Every small duty in Southshore helps keep the Alliance's main stronghold in Lordaeron fortified against threats from the north and sea.
As a human traveler, you see the strained bureaucracy and frontier weariness of Hillsbrad's garrison in your dealings with Farren and Redpath.
